scenes.vo: There's a man in the background of every photo I take. And he's getting closer.
scenes.cap: A man in the background of every photo. Getting closer.

scenes.vo: First, the beach. A tiny figure near the water. I didn't notice him until I zoomed in.
scenes.cap: Photo 1: a tiny figure, far away

scenes.vo: A week later, a cafe. He was at the next table. Same shirt. Looking at the camera.
scenes.cap: Photo 2: the next table. Same shirt.

scenes.vo: Yesterday, a selfie in my room. He was standing right behind my shoulder.
scenes.cap: Yesterday's selfie: right behind my shoulder.

scenes.vo: I turned around. Nobody. But in the selfie, he's holding up his own phone. Taking a photo of me.
scenes.cap: In the selfie he's holding a phone. Pointed at me.

scenes.vo: I zoomed in on his screen. It's his photo of his room. And in the background, it's me. Getting closer.
scenes.cap: On his screen: his room. And in the background... me.
